long_description: Groundcover develops cloud-native observability software that enables organizations to monitor applications, infrastructure, and Kubernetes environments through a unified platform. The company provides tools for application performance monitoring, log management, distributed tracing, infrastructure monitoring, real user monitoring, and artificial intelligence workload observability. Its platform uses eBPF-based data collection, OpenTelemetry integration, and a Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) architecture to capture and process telemetry data while allowing customers to retain observability data within their own cloud environments. Groundcover also offers automation capabilities, alerting, dashboards, integrations with cloud services and developer tools, and AI-assisted workflows that help engineering teams investigate incidents and manage production systems. The company's technology supports software development, site reliability engineering, DevOps, and IT operations by providing visibility into application behavior, infrastructure performance, and system health across cloud-native environments.
